chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Walīd, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a جنازة that I did not catch until it had reached the grave: should I perform salat over it? He said: If you reach it before it is buried, then if you wish, perform salat over it.

key_terms.أُصَلِّي: I perform salat, here meaning the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْجِنَازَةِ: the funeral bier or deceased prepared for funeral rites
key_terms.الْقَبْرَ: the grave, where burial is to take place
key_terms.تُدْفَنَ: to be buried in the grave

ai.seo_question: Can funeral salat be performed after the جنازة has reached the grave but before burial?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat over a جنازة when one did not catch it earlier and only reached it at the قبر. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that if the deceased has not yet been buried, one may still perform the funeral salat over it.
